name: RISC-16
description: A load/store machine inspired by ARM, kept simple: four explicit registers R0-R3 with R0 as the accumulator, registers named in the mnemonic (MOV_R1_R0, ADD_R2), memory reached only through LDR/STR via an address register, conditional branches on the CPSR flags and BL/RET with a link register.

programs.name: Hello, world on the LCD
programs.description: A print subroutine called with BL, walking the string with LDR_R1

programs.name: Fibonacci on the LCD
programs.description: Stops on the ADD carry; decimal printing by repeated subtraction

programs.name: Colour gradient on the screen
programs.description: Red left to right, green top to bottom

programs.name: Sketch with the arrow keys
programs.description: Reads the keypad with IN: the arrows move a pen, space changes its colour
